title: Amanchu! Yakusoku no Natsu to Atarashii Omoide no Koto
justification: AniList 98536 (OVA, 1 episode from 2017-03-29) is AniDB 11683's special S1 Yakusoku no Natsu to Atarashii Omoide no Koto (The Story of the Promised Summer and New Memories), aired 2017-03-29. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 21406, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 11683, and the special's title matches AniList's romaji, English and native titles. The parent has no row for S1, so it lands on TVDB 0x1 The Story of the Promised Summer and New Memories (2017-03-29) and on TMDB 67346 S0E1 (2017-03-29).
